appraisal_events.evidence: "le véritable clou de la matinée"... "c'était un vieux mendiant qui n'inspirait plus aucun respect"... "le plus fier visage, le torse le plus cambré n'était plus qu'une loque en bouillie"; the narrator has "un fou rire devant ce sublime gaga".
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's former proud, hostile, and feared adversary is shown transformed by age-makeup into a pathetic, tottering, laughable figure who commands no respect at all, the most extreme case of decline among all the disguised guests.

status_effects.explanation: He is reduced from a formidable, hostile figure to a comic, pathetic 'gaga' who inspires laughter rather than respect or fear.

His formerly imposing, haughty bearing ('rogue, hostile et dangereux') is replaced by the demeanor of a harmless old beggar/doddering fool, stripping him of the dignity his social position previously commanded.

ambiguities: The narrator's diminishment of d'Argencourt is double-edged: alongside the loss of dignity and respect, the narrator also experiences him as newly harmless and inoffensive rather than purely mocked, softening the negative reading without overturning it.
